title: Club Sands and the small band with Joe Snider
summary: Jiles played a three-piece job at Club Sands with Snider, and they recall the others in the band.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: I mean it's too big about four pieces.
You know there's a place on the 1300 block of St. Charles, I think it's called the Club Sands.
Well yeah I played there with Joe Snider.
Yeah I used to come there.
